issues.detail: The Hebrew lists Merari's sons: Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah. The Chinese renders 'לִבְנִי' (Libni) as '利比尼人' (Libni people) and 'שִׁמְעִי' (Shimei) as '希瑪利人' (Shimari people), adding '人' (people) and changing Shimei to a different name (希瑪利 instead of 希每/示每). Also, the final 'עֻזָּה בְנוֹ' (Uzzah his son) is rendered as '烏撒的兒子' (Uzzah's son), which reverses the relationship — the Hebrew says Uzzah is the son, not that Uzzah has a son.
